text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Th-that race was out of this world! Did
you see
Mejiro Ardan?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah,
that was a sick race... I actually think
maybe she could go toe-to-toe
with Oguri Cap,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Geez. I can't even imagine what'd
happen if those
two went up against
each other right now...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I just can't get enough of this.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And I can't wait until our next bout
either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...I can feel it.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The places we were destined for in
history... are
changing for each of us.)

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O and Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
Ardan!
Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I did it... I overcame my limits, too...
What an
amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This race was testament to the endless
potential
each of us possesses.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I agree, truly. It was a miraculous race
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O. Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you're my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: When next we race, I shall—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, I will—

text_block_list.name: Ardan, Chiyono O, an...
text_block_list.text: Win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day after the Takarazuka Kinen,
and
Mejiro Ardan and I are having a
discussion to
decide her next goal race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It is my wish to race against Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan looks me in the eye as she
speaks
with absolute conviction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I believe that time is precisely now.
choice_data_list: So the time is ripe, huh?
So the time is ripe, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
At yesterday's Takarazuka Kinen, I went
up
against Inari—a racer said to be a
pillar of our
generation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Although she was certainly a formidable

opponent... I do believe that I managed
to hold
my own against her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have rivals, whom I cherish very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And they have lifted me up to such
heights that
I'm now able to compete
with Inari.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wonder... If I were to compete against Oguri—as I am now—what sort of result might that yield?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My body aches for the opportunity to
find out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please do share your thoughts on this
matter,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can see it myself, too. Mejiro Ardan has
attained extraordinary strength through
all those intense
clashes against her
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I have no problem with
her
competing with Oguri Cap as the
culmination of
her senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt in my mind that Oguri
Cap will
make an appearance there. As
to why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's a storied stage,
perfectly fitting for a turning
point in history. Racers from far
and wide are sure to gather in shared
pursuit of the title of "the greatest."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, I noticed that your exact
words were
"ultimate goal"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My plan is to see how she runs in the
Mainichi
Okan, then make adjustments
before the autumn
Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: Before that, we'll enter the Maini...
Before that, we're entering the Ma...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, if we're lucky, Oguri Cap
might even show up at the Mainichi
Okan. If she does, I'll be able to get a
better read on what she's
capable of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Well then, let's make today
the
beginning of our progress toward the
Mainichi
Okan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The culmination of Mejiro Ardan's senior
year
awaits... But before that, the
Mainichi Okan!
